description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the other Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When the Hero dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the Hero enters, Black Panther triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
